title: Detailed toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- shadow beneath block -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="34" ry="6" fill="#2a1f4a"/>

  <!-- main cube body - red front face -->
  <rect x="18" y="30" width="64" height="54" rx="3" fill="#e03040"/>

  <!-- slightly lighter red panel inset on front -->
  <rect x="23" y="35" width="54" height="44" rx="2" fill="#f05058"/>

  <!-- top face - lighter orange-red for depth -->
  <polygon points="18,30 82,30 88,22 24,22" fill="#ff9068"/>

  <!-- right face - darker red for shading -->
  <polygon points="82,30 88,22 88,76 82,84" fill="#b82030"/>

  <!-- top face studs (circles on top plane, appearing as ellipses) -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="26" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffb090"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="26" rx="5" ry="2.8" fill="#ffd0b8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="26" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffb090"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="26" rx="5" ry="2.8" fill="#ffd0b8"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="26" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffb090"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="26" rx="5" ry="2.8" fill="#ffd0b8"/>

  <!-- left edge highlight line -->
  <line x1="18" y1="30" x2="18" y2="84" stroke="#ff7078" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- front face decorative studs (raised dots) -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="48" r="5" fill="#b82030"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#ff6070"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="5" fill="#b82030"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#ff6070"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="48" r="5" fill="#b82030"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#ff6070"/>

  <!-- bottom front row studs -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="64" r="5" fill="#b82030"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="64" r="3.5" fill="#ff6070"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="64" r="5" fill="#b82030"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="64" r="3.5" fill="#ff6070"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="64" r="5" fill="#b82030"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="64" r="3.5" fill="#ff6070"/>

  <!-- yellow letter block detail - a big star or simple shape on front -->
  <polygon points="50,38 52.5,43.5 58,44 54,48 55.5,53.5 50,50.5 44.5,53.5 46,48 42,44 47.5,43.5" fill="#ffd040"/>

  <!-- right side studs seen on top edge of right face -->
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="28" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#d03040"/>
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="48" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#d03040"/>
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="68" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#d03040"/>
</svg>
